photos.description: Sunset over a German river winding between steep vineyard slopes, vines in the foreground
German wine village with a church steeple, surrounded by individual vineyard parcels on steep hillsides
A single vine trunk with leaves and green grape clusters in sunlight (Mendoza, Argentina)
Harvest: a picker stacking crates of black Nebbiolo grapes in a vineyard at Serralunga, Piedmont
Long row of stainless steel fermentation tanks in a winery cellar
Aerial view of a hill village surrounded by green vineyards, with the plain stretching out behind (returned for 'Lombardy vineyard'; exact location not stated)
Crate of freshly picked white grapes during harvest in a vineyard in Puglia
Restaurant table set for service: white cloth, polished wine and water glasses, cutlery laid out
Black-and-white shot of stemmed wine glasses and tumblers on a set table, light through the glass
Bottles stacked on their sides in a cellar, seen end-on (bottle bases only, no labels)
Low sun over vineyard rows near Cafayate, Salta, with the Andes foothills on the horizon
Rugged, sun-baked hills around Torroja del Priorat with the Montsant cliffs behind
Aerial view of a green vineyard ringed by pine woods in Portugal (northern Portugal look; exact location not stated)
Autumn vineyard rows leading to the village of Verzenay, Champagne, under a blue sky
Looking down a row of vines toward hazy hills in Piedmont's Langhe (returned for 'Langhe vineyards')
Vineyards inside a bend of the Ebro river, Rioja, patchwork of vineyard plots beyond
Sonoma vineyard rows on a slope with oak-covered hills behind
Unbranded glass of white wine in soft light, a row of tasting glasses blurred behind
